dimensions.assessment: Directly affects the members of the Miccosukee Tribe of Indians living in Osceola Camp and federal park administration.
dimensions.evidence: Miccosukee Tribe of Indians, must take appropriate actions to protect structures within the Osceola Camp from flooding

dimensions.assessment: Expands a designated tribal area boundary and mandates specific federal engineering or protective actions against flooding.
dimensions.evidence: take appropriate actions to protect structures within the area described in section 4(4)(C) from flooding

dimensions.assessment: Requires federal flood protection actions, but the source text does not state specific funding amounts or appropriations.
Amends the Miccosukee Reserved Area Act to modify a specific park boundary and mandate local flood protection work.
dimensions.evidence: Section 4(4) of the Miccosukee Reserved Area Act (16 U.S.C. 410 note; Public Law 105-313) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory expansion of the reserved area boundary, paired with a 2-year deadline to initiate flood protection actions.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 2 years after the date of enactment of this subsection, the Secretary... shall take appropriate actions

missing_information: Estimated financial cost of carrying out flood protection activities at Osceola Camp.
importance_detail.rationale: Expands the Miccosukee Reserved Area in Florida to include the Osceola Camp and requires the Secretary of the Interior to take actions to protect structures within the camp from flooding within two years.
